title: Genesys Growth SKILL.md frontmatter (Phase 4 locked-down spec)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of every active SKILL.md across .claude/skills/. Locked-down spec adopted Phase 4 (2026-04-29) to make the catalog auto-syncable and the chain graph queryable. Source of truth for ontology_type / primitive enums: .claude/rules/ontology.md.

name.description: Slug-style skill identifier (lowercase, hyphens, no spaces). Must match the parent folder name.

author.description: Skill author. Defaults to genesys-growth for first-party skills.

last_updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last meaningful edit to skill behavior.

description.description: Single-paragraph description used by Claude Code for trigger matching. Min 80 chars to enforce useful detail.

goal.description: One-sentence outcome — what the skill produces. Imperative voice ("Develop a positioning strategy with...").

outcome.description: What the locked artifact contains and what it unblocks downstream.

primitive.description: Top-level GTM primitive grouping. Drives folder placement under .claude/skills/{primitives|meta}/. `ops` = Genesys-internal business operations (e.g. company-cfo).

sub_primitive.description: Sub-primitive grouping (audit/strategy/execution for most primitives, channel-specific for social, role-specific for meta, motion for video render skills).

ontology_type.description: Knowledge type from .claude/rules/ontology.md. Drives output classification + downstream consumer routing.

required.description: Skills whose output must exist before this skill can run.

recommended.description: Skills whose output meaningfully improves this skill's quality.

inputs.description: Upstream skill dependencies. The required list mirrors depends_on.

type.description: Knowledge type from ontology.md. Usually matches top-level ontology_type.

outputs.description: Structured output declarations. At least one entry required.

depends_on.description: Flat list of upstream skill slugs. Mirrors inputs.required for chain-lint queries.

feeds_into.description: Flat list of downstream skill slugs. Mirrors outputs[].feeds_into for chain-lint queries.

owned_by_agent.description: Role-agent that executes this skill. Mirrors the role-agent roster in .claude/agents/.

mcps_used.description: MCP servers this skill calls. Used for credit-gate routing and skill-injection.

push_targets.description: Publishable destinations. Empty array if skill output stays local-only.

slash_commands.description: Slash commands in .claude/commands/ that invoke this skill.

natural_language.description: Phrase fragments that auto-suggest this skill. Used by orchestrator + Claude Code triggering.

status.description: Lifecycle state. draft=Phase 4 default; locked=team-approved canonical reference.

locked_by.description: Who approved the lock ("Team", "Genesys", or null while draft).

locked_date.description: ISO date of lock. Null while draft.

lock_version.description: Increments with each unlock-refresh-relock cycle. Null while draft.

sources_count.description: Count of inputs verified during last run. 0 at rollout; populated on first execution.

context.description: Legacy field — context strategy. fork=copy parent context, inherit=share, fresh=clean slate.

paths.description: Legacy field — glob hint for which workspace paths this skill applies to.

disable-model-invocation.description: Legacy field — if true, skill is internal-only (no auto-invoke).

slim_exemption.description: Documented reason this SKILL.md exceeds the 300-line slim discipline cap. When set, Gate 8 verification accepts this file as a known exception. Format: brief-reason-YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 'gbp-split-deferred-2026-04-30'). Default null/absent — most skills should slim, not exempt.
